name: [Sigma] Crypto-Mining Host Reconnaissance Commands
description:
Commands that check for competing miner processes or count CPU cores,
which is how cryptojacking bots size a host and look for rivals before
dropping a miner. Written against commands observed in the archived dataset
(e.g. "ps -ef | grep '[Mm]iner'", "cat /proc/cpuinfo | grep name | wc -l").
query: from cowrie-* metadata _id, _index, _version | where event.action=="cowrie.command.input" and (process.command_line like "*[Mm]iner*" or process.command_line like "*xmrig*" or process.command_line like "*/proc/cpuinfo*" and process.command_line like "*wc -l*")
false_positives: Administrators checking CPU count or hunting for miners themselves
author: dram64
